A slice of an App that can be switched on together: it restates the App's own content keys. **Preview** keys work and may change in any release ([status](/docs/status/)); the rest are stable. [All parts](/docs/app-dsl/).

A feature keeps one capability (its resources' presentation, views, pages,
menu fragment and grants) in one module, merged into the App at load.

```ts title="app.ts"
import { defineApp, defineFeature, listView, navGroup } from '@mistriwork/mistri/app';

const inventory = defineFeature({
  id: 'inventory',
  resources: { vehicle: { display: { price: { format: 'money' } } } },
  auth: { roles: { clerk: { read: ['vehicle'] } } },
  views: { vehicles: listView('Vehicles', 'vehicle', { show: ['name', 'price'] }) },
  nav: ['vehicles'],
});

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Dealership',
  resources: { lead: { access: 'write' }, vehicle: {} },
  auth: { roles: { clerk: { label: 'Clerk', read: ['lead'], write: ['lead'] } } },
  views: { leads: listView('Leads', 'lead') },
  features: [inventory],
  home: 'leads',
  nav: [navGroup('work', 'Work', ['leads', { feature: 'inventory' }])],
});
```

The App keeps `name`, `connection`, `sources`, `ui`, sign-in and which roles
exist. Ids are global; identical facts merge and conflicting ones are refused
naming both contributors; actions and validation rules concatenate; authority
only adds. Put each feature in `features/<id>.ts`, which reload watches.

## The authority lock

```sh
npx @mistriwork/mistri check --config mistri.json --app . --write-authority
```

writes `authority.lock` beside the App: every grant, ceiling, deletion
opt-in, public read, source binding and component origin, one line each,
naming who contributes it (`role clerk read vehicle — features "inventory"`).
From then on `check` fails with the difference whenever the App's authority
changes, the server refuses to start an App that differs from its lock, and a
reload that changes authority waits for a restart. Review the diff, then
rewrite the lock.

## `features`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `features` | array | Stable | Ordered slices of content merged at load, every merge checked: views, pages, a nav fragment the App places with { feature }, how resources present, home rules appended after the App's, and grants to the App's roles within its ceilings. Identical facts merge; conflicting ones are refused, naming both contributors. |

## `features[].auth`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `features[].auth` | object | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles` | object | Stable | Grants to roles the App declares in auth.roles; a feature never creates a role. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.actions` | object | Stable | Fixed actions the role runs without write, by resource and action id: { pay_run: ['submit'] }. Each resource is one the role reads, with access 'write', and does not write; each id is one of its fixed (set) actions. The server admits the update only as that action: its set, its reason column, its when on the stored row. Needs auth.rows 'all'. Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.commands` | array | Stable | Explicit server command identifiers only. No wildcard grants or implied CRUD access. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.experiments` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.experiments[].actions` | array | Preview |  Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.experiments[].environments` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.experiments[].ids` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.experiments[].owners` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.fields` | object | Stable | Column narrowing per resource, within the resource's own fields. Omit read to narrow only write. Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.fields.*.read` | array | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.fields.*.write` | array | Stable | Needs the resource's access 'write'. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.flags` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.flags[].actions` | array | Preview |  Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.flags[].environments` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.flags[].ids` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.flags[].owners` | array | Preview |  |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.operations` | array | Stable | Operator reads over the authenticated App host: readiness, bundle (the sanitized support bundle) and workflows (the durable workflows room, with Cancel and Retry). In a suite's Console, for this App only: workflows, jobs (list and redrive), deliveries (event and webhook deliveries, list and redrive), stores (store layout status) and analytics (read-only). Independent of data and command grants. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.read` | array | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.realm` | `"tenant"` · `"platform"` | Stable | May only restate an identical, explicitly declared root role realm. Cross-contributor agreement is checked by the App checker; a feature cannot introduce a realm. One of `platform`, `tenant`. |
| `features[].auth.roles.*.write` | array | Stable | Within the role's reads and the App's write ceiling. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
